dem.nodata_policy: metric UNKNOWN if any required neighborhood cannot be resolved; no synthetic elevation fill across basin boundary

polygon_metrics.area_km2: project frozen basin polygon to EPSG:32718; planar area / 1e6
polygon_metrics.perimeter_km: project frozen basin polygon to EPSG:32718; exterior plus interior ring lengths / 1000

elevation_metrics.mask_rule: include DEM cells whose centers fall inside frozen basin polygon

slope_metrics.algorithm: Horn 3x3 finite-difference slope on 30 m projected DEM
slope_metrics.mask_rule: report only cells whose centers fall inside frozen basin polygon and have complete valid 3x3 DEM neighborhood

hydrology_metrics.main_channel_length_m: longest flow-path distance from any in-basin cell to the frozen outlet, measured along D8 cell-center links; no channel-threshold tuning

drainage_density_km_per_km2.channel_definition: D8 cells with contributing area >= 1 percent of the frozen basin polygon area
drainage_density_km_per_km2.length_measurement: sum downstream D8 link lengths for qualifying in-basin channel cells, counting each directed link once
drainage_density_km_per_km2.sensitivity_status: METHOD_SPECIFIC; any alternative threshold belongs to a later sensitivity analysis and cannot replace this frozen primary value

freeze_and_compare.phase_1: compute all DEM-derived values and input/code hashes; write immutable morphometry output with A6680 reference unread
freeze_and_compare.phase_3: only then read the sealed A6680 numeric reference and compute signed difference, absolute difference and percent difference where denominator is nonzero
forbidden: move outlet to improve agreement with A6680
change DEM conditioning to improve agreement
discard a target because agreement is poor

comparison_interpretation: Differences quantify method/data disagreement; A6680 is an external reference, not a calibration target or geometry-selection oracle.
